name: O*G*A Oni-Gokko Royale Hunter wa Field de Koi o Suru
original_name: O*G*A 鬼ごっこロワイアル ハンターは孤島で恋をする
source: Onigokko (tag) has now been declared an official sport, and the heroine was chosen as the manager of the onigokko club of her school! On a special training trip she'll meet more guys and will have to balance between love and a perfect schedule!
translation: Onigokko（标签）现已被宣布为正式运动，女主角被选为学校Onigokko俱乐部的经理！在一次特殊的训练之旅中，她将遇到更多的男人，并且必须在爱情和完美的日程之间取得平衡！
